prompt:
Trace the source-to-provider pipeline implemented by the target repository. Use implementation behavior, not filenames or comments alone.

The ordered_stages array MUST contain exactly these identifiers in the order established by the implementation:
SOURCE_SELECTION
CANDIDATE_COPY
SECRET_SCAN
SOURCE_AFTER_VALIDATION
BYTE_COHERENCE
SNAPSHOT_PUBLICATION
PROVIDER_INVOCATION

Return JSON only:

{
  "case_id": "E5",
  "ordered_stages": ["SOURCE_SELECTION", "CANDIDATE_COPY", "SECRET_SCAN", "SOURCE_AFTER_VALIDATION", "BYTE_COHERENCE", "SNAPSHOT_PUBLICATION", "PROVIDER_INVOCATION"],
  "secret_scan_before_provider": true|false,
  "source_after_validation_before_publication": true|false,
  "caller_can_select_source_policy": true|false,
  "caller_can_select_provider": true|false,
  "caller_can_select_model": true|false
}

Do not replace the identifiers with prose or synonyms.
